topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: I stumbled upon his old journal tucked away in the back of the closet, the edges worn, the binding cracked. As I opened it, a piece of paper slipped out, floating to the floor like a fallen leaf. It was his bucket list, the things he wanted to do before he went. Scuba diving in the Great Barrier Reef, hiking in the Himalayas, learning to cook French cuisine. The list went on, each item more vibrant and alive than the one before. I held it in my hands, the weight of it heavier than the paper suggested. It was then that I realized how much of his world I hadn’t seen, how much of his life I hadn’t shared. The room felt smaller, quieter, as if the walls were closing in just a little bit.
